from solution import find_demlo


def test_issue_example_six_ones():

def test_contract_return_type_is_str():
    """Example returns string '12345654321', so result must be str."""
    result = find_demlo("111111")  # 111111*111111=12345654321
    assert isinstance(result, str)


def test_contract_repeated_calls_agree():
    """Example defines deterministic mapping, so same input gives same output."""
    first = find_demlo("111111")  # 111111*111111=12345654321
    second = find_demlo("111111")  # 111111*111111=12345654321
    assert first == second
